name: Encryption
description: Encrypt and decrypt with AES, SM4 and ChaCha20, generate, use and verify RSA keys, and debug SM2 signatures
help: Symmetric: AES (GCM, CBC, CTR, ECB), SM4 and ChaCha20-Poly1305. Keys can be hex, Base64, text or a password derived with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.
When encrypting, an empty IV or nonce is generated randomly. Turn on “Put IV before ciphertext” to store it at the start of the output; decryption then reads it from there.
RSA: generate 2048–4096-bit key pairs (PKCS#8 or PKCS#1 PEM), encrypt with OAEP or PKCS#1 v1.5, and sign or verify with PKCS#1 v1.5 or PSS.

SM2 signatures: sign and verify SM2-with-SM3 per GB/T 32918.2-2016. The user ID (default 1234567812345678) and the public key go into ZA, then e = SM3(ZA ‖ message); signatures can be ASN.1 DER or 64-byte r ‖ s. Private keys stay on this page and are written to a file only when you export them.
Results are compatible with OpenSSL. Nothing you type here is saved.

symmetric.ecbWarning: ECB leaks patterns in the data; prefer GCM.
